candidates.source_name: MNB Intézménykereső (Institution Finder / market participants register)
candidates.why_relevant: Master searchable register of every financial organisation holding an MNB licence or registered by the MNB (banks, e-money issuers, payment institutions, AISP/PISP, intermediaries). It is the definitive index of who exists in HU banking/payments and therefore who else publishes data; the anchor for actor-map snowballing for POS/ATM/card ecosystem players.
candidates.legal_status: official public register published by the central bank/supervisor
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic (monthly) scrape or manual export of search result lists per institution type; check for an underlying JSON/XHR endpoint behind the search UI before HTML scraping. Store entity name + MNB registration number as the join key for the actor map.
candidates.discovered_via_method: hu-language seed search on register terminology, confirmed by en-language search on 'register of payment institutions'
queries_used: MNB engedélyezett pénzforgalmi intézmények nyilvántartás lista

negative_findings.description: No documented bulk export, open-data dump or public API was found for the MNB Intézménykereső / Piaci szereplők keresése register during this scouting pass; the surfaces found are interactive search UIs.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches surfaced only the search interfaces (intezmenykereso.mnb.hu, mnb.hu piaci szereplők keresése) and no data.gov-style export endpoint.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Automated actor-map maintenance may require HTML/XHR scraping of the MNB UI, or falling back to the EBA central register bulk download, which is authoritative only for PSD2-scope entities (not for all credit institutions).

negative_findings.description: No MNB register specifically listing ATM operators, POS acquirers or terminal deployers as a distinct licensed category was found. Acquiring appears only as an activity inside payment-institution/credit-institution licences.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches on payment-institution licensing taxonomy and registers returned licence-category pages but nothing enumerating ATM/POS network operators.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Identifying the HU POS/ATM operator landscape (directly relevant to a terminal-hardware market view) will need derivation from licence-activity fields plus the Payment Systems Report aggregates, not a single register.

negative_findings.description: A 2026 edition of the Fizetési rendszer jelentés was not located; only editions through 2025 were surfaced.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search results list 2023/2024/2025 editions and a publication calendar page; the 2026 edition may exist but was not confirmed in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Latest-vintage figures may be missing; the publication calendar should be consulted to schedule the check rather than assuming absence.

negative_findings.description: All URLs in this slice come from search results or from two pages fetched successfully (MNB EN market participants, statisztika.mnb.hu supervisory statistics). The remaining URLs were not individually fetched and are therefore unverified for liveness.
negative_findings.result_summary: No fetch failures were observed; no URL is asserted here as verified reachable.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The deterministic verification pass must resolve every URL; MNB path structures are long and have been reorganised historically (an /archivum/ tree exists), so 404-and-move is plausible for older paths.

coverage_gaps.description: It is unknown which fields the Intézménykereső exposes per entity (licence number, activity codes, licence date, status, address, ownership) and whether historic/withdrawn licences remain queryable.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run an interactive session against intezmenykereso.mnb.hu, inspect the network calls behind the search form, and document the field schema plus whether revoked entries persist.

coverage_gaps.description: Registers likely relevant to the payments actor map were not explored in this cell: virtual-asset/crypto service provider registration under MiCA, the MNB's cash-processing (készpénzfeldolgozó) authorisations, and the payment/securities settlement system oversight lists (GIRO, KELER, VIBER operators).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend searches with 'MNB kriptoeszköz-szolgáltató nyilvántartás MiCA', 'MNB készpénzfeldolgozási tevékenység engedély', 'MNB felvigyázás fizetési rendszer GIRO KELER VIBER'.

coverage_gaps.description: For several HU-language sources (Fizetési rendszer jelentés, FinTech report, Aranykönyv, decisions search) the exact English-edition URLs were not captured, only their existence inferred.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Map each HU page to its /en/ counterpart and record both URLs, so downstream collection can pick the language with the richer data tables.

coverage_gaps.description: An MNB archive tree (www.mnb.hu/archivum/...) holds legacy PSZAF-era supervisory statistics including older Aranykönyv editions, but its structure and coverage span were not mapped.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Crawl the /archivum/Felugyelet/ tree to establish how far back per-institution supervisory data reaches and where the break in methodology (PSZAF to MNB, 2013) sits.

brief: Hungary's supervisory/registry layer is unusually concentrated: the MNB is the single integrated authority, so one institution (mnb.hu plus the statisztika.mnb.hu and intezmenykereso.mnb.hu subdomains) holds the definitive index of every bank, e-money issuer, payment institution and PSD2 third-party provider operating in the country. The strongest pointer assets are the Intézménykereső search register, the open-banking ASPSP and AISP/PISP lists, and the Határozatok és végzések decision database, which together give both a current actor map and an entry/exit signal; the EBA PSD2 central register is the machine-readable mirror when automation matters. On the analytical side the Aranykönyv provides per-institution financials as a time series, while the Fizetési rendszer jelentés, the FinTech és Digitalizációs jelentés, Hitelintézeti Szemle and the MNB-tanulmányok series carry aggregate card, POS/ATM and cash-usage statistics with methodology. The main structural gap is that no register enumerates POS acquirers or ATM operators as such — that landscape must be derived from licence-activity fields cross-referenced with the payment reports.
